Plotted and read x-t graphs; practised using slope as velocity, with consistency still to check next time.
Read v-t graphs and used slope for acceleration; consistency still to check next time.
Interpreted graph sections as rest, steady motion, speeding up and braking; applying this to new graphs is still to check.
Calculated v-t areas of 120 m, 20 m and a total of 210 m in the examples.
end.parentNote: Asha practised reading x-t and v-t graphs through slopes, flat sections, and areas, then turned graph sections into a motion story. Ira used the methods to calculate velocity, acceleration, and total distance; no specific mix-up was observed or corrected later. At home, ask them to describe one new graph in words first, then identify its slope or area and explain what it represents.
